@Space_Station Headed home! Crew-12 has undocked from the @Space_Station in their Dragon spacecraft.

They'll splash down in the Pacific Ocean tomorrow, Oct. 8 — tune in here for live coverage starting at 10:20am ET (1420 UTC). https://t.co/biRPoxjCi0

LIVE: The members of Crew-12 are inside their spacecraft and ready to head back to Earth. Watch as they undock from the @Space_Station around 8:05am ET (1205 UTC) and begin their trip home. https://t.co/jpGZbjsmtn

RT @NASADepAdmin: The Artemis Accords community keeps growing, and so do our opportunities to collaborate.

Today’s annual Artemis Accords…
